headline: Bars in Crisis: Tuscany Loses Over 800 Businesses in Six Years; Data Province by Province
summary: More than 800 bar-sector businesses disappeared in Tuscany between 2019 and 2025. The province of Florence accounted for a decline of about 300 establishments.
why: Hospitality and bar businesses are a significant part of tourism-driven local economies, and closures signal pressure on consumer services.
